description: Casernes de sapeurs-pompiers du Var is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by remocra.sapeurspompiers-var.fr. Location of fire stations in the department of Var. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Fire stations of the Var" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2016-01-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
